articles.headline: ASU asks ex-state justice to lead review of hockey player's collapse
articles.description: Arizona State has asked a former chief justice of the Arizona Supreme Court to lead an independent review of the collapse of hockey player Matthew Mayich during an outdoor workout in August.

articles.headline: Penguins' Kuzmenko to wear No. 62 to honor dad killed in bear attack
articles.description: Penguins forward Andrei Kuzmenko will change his jersey number to 62 in honor of his father, who was killed in a bear attack in Russia last week at age 62.

articles.headline: Amid trade request, Red Wings move Larkin to injured reserve
articles.description: Hours before the season opener on home ice against the New York Rangers, the Detroit Red Wings moved former captain Dylan Larkin, 30, to a non-roster injured reserve spot, while the organization continues to deal with his lingering trade request.

articles.headline: PWHL adds 6-team conferences, quarterfinal playoff round
articles.description: The PWHL's addition of four teams is translating into more games, an expanded playoff format and two six-team conferences as the league enters its fourth season.

images.name: PWHL logo [600x400]
images.caption: The PWHL is revamping its expansion rules, including the elimination of an expansion player draft, in preparing to add as many as four markets for next season, including Detroit, which was added on Wednesday.
